description: Election Commission - Filling of a Vacancy in the office of the Vice Chairman of the Gomarankadawala Pradeshiya Sabha.
reasoning: The gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in the office of Vice Chairman of a local authority (Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the procedural steps triggered by a vacancy, the nomination by a political party, and the formal declaration of the newly elected Vice Chairman by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under electoral processes at the local government level, making it an **Elections Gazette**.
